games.name: BitLoaf

Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

games.name: Butaro's Overtime Office
games.summary: Adopt a burnt-out salaryman who lives on your screen and works alongside you! Help Butaro destress from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and unlock some stylish hats while you work or relax. Has your Butaro escaped capitalism faster than you have?

games.name: Colorways
games.summary: Manage the Colorways safely and efficiently - control colorful traffic through various intersections and avoid traffic jams and accidents. Compete against the world's best traffic controllers to climb the leaderboards.

games.name: Cooking Adventure

games.name: Core Logistics

games.name: Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
games.summary: A cozy companion for work and study. Share your focus time with a cat, decorate your room, and find your rhythm with a flexible timer and gentle music. As you focus, your cat levels up and new furniture and designs become available.

games.name: Cube Fold

games.name: Desert Survivors
games.summary: Destroy the endless monsters of the desert and break this curse! Choose your character, combine your abilities, and build your own devastating synergies. Can you withstand the ruthlessness of the desert?

games.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
games.summary: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.

games.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree - Water Park
Don't Panic, Defend!

games.name: Dreadgence

games.name: Egg Harvest
games.summary: Egg Harvest is a roguelike farming game where you try to save your farm from debt. Produce eggs with your chickens, complete contracts, choose powerful upgrades, and fill your egg catalog. Keep producing until your debt is paid off!

games.name: EmergenHex
games.summary: Solve combat puzzles with your build-crafted loadout, automate conquered nodes across a haunted hex map for loot, and upgrade your skills, passives, and gear. Master 70+ handcrafted encounters, then enter a harder phase where the rules change for all encounters!

games.name: ETCH
games.summary: A fast top-down roguelike maze-runner. You're a PSI-class Runner, the one unit they can't capture. Slip into a Tracer-held sector, bring its cores online, and take it back before they close in.

games.name: EverArcane
games.summary: Build a 3×3 grid of spells and watch your young mage obliterate endless monster hordes. Combine six elements, chain reactions and adjacency buffs, defeat ten Guardians, and push through the horde of monsters.

games.name: Express Lane
games.summary: Run your own cozy little grocery shop! Stock the shelves, flip the sign to OPEN, and pack every shopper's groceries with real physics until they fit just right. Then build your shop the way you like it, hire help, ship online orders and grow from a tiny corner store into a busy market.

games.name: Feed The Vessel
games.summary: An incremental game where you keep a hungry god fed across hundreds of light-years of empty space. Grow clones in vats, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

games.name: Flip & Conquer
games.summary: A coin decides every battle — you decide everything else: the target, the stake, the cards you spring. Not luck, nerve. Wager one square or your whole border and take the map. Learn it in one round, play it all night — up to 8 empires online, or a branching campaign solo.

games.name: Game Dev Dynasty
games.summary: **ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE NOW** There's a problem in paradise and it ain't pretty! In Super Zombie Shooter you can... - Kill zombies (YEEEEEH!) - Dodge deadly meteors - Collect coins - Unlock new characters - Fight for freedom and save 'mercia - gamecenter leaderboards - compete for highest score - Blow up stuffs More braaaaaains now for FREE!

games.name: Glowgrove
games.summary: Grow a cozy mushroom garden that keeps growing while you're away. Plant spore packets in six painted habitats, mist your mushrooms, discover 42 species and their rare variants, cross them into hybrids, and watch the grove glow at night.

games.name: God of War Sons of Sparta
games.summary:
Join young Kratos and Deimos, sons of Sparta, on a Greek odyssey as they discover the meaning of duty and honor. BEFORE THE LEGEND. Every legend has a beginning – before he was a God, before he was a father, Kratos was a young Spartan!
Experience an untold chapter in Kratos’ journey set during the harsh years of Spartan training alongside his brother Deimos. Through endless trials, their minds, bodies, and hearts have been molded to become Spartan soldiers for whom duty and honor mean everything.
After a fellow cadet goes missing, Kratos and Deimos vow to find him and embark on an adventure that will put their training and Spartan spirit to the test.

DUTY AND HONOR
Guide Kratos and Deimos through vibrant and varied 2D levels that will test your combat prowess and cleverness as you search for their missing friend. Solve environmental puzzles, face down enemies both new and familiar, and topple mythological bosses that will test the limits of your Spartan training. Through adversity and cooperation, they’ll learn what it means to be a true Spartan, brother, and friend.

RETRO MEETS GOD OF WAR
An engaging and exciting 2D action-adventure brought to life from the talented pixel superstars at Mega Cat Studios. Experience retro classic gameplay with God of War’s signature spectacle, action, and heartfelt storytelling.

games.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush - Supporter Pack
Gramps & Whiskers
games.summary: A grumpy old fisherman sits on your Windows taskbar and fishes while you work. His cat climbs your windows, naps on his lap and steals his catch. Dress them both up with hats and gear that grandpa fishes up along the way.

games.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
games.summary: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

games.name: Here Comes the Horde
games.summary: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where you defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Earn coins, improve your army, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

games.name: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
games.summary: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

games.name: Hungry Hoist
games.summary: Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda! Hungry Hoist is a solo or co-op dungeon-crawler about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with.

games.name: IJIN: History Survivors
games.summary: Who's the strongest in history? Become Napoleon, Musashi, or Cleopatra and mow down huge hordes in survivors-style action. Just move — attacks are automatic. Evolve each legend's weapon into their myth. Ice at Austerlitz, fog at Sekigahara rewrite the battlefield. 4-player online/local co-op.

games.name: Imperionis
games.summary: Imperionis is a tactical RPG about a Roman commander. Develop your century, unlock new units and characters, resolve events through D20 checks, and fight hex-based battles and personal duels-manually or through real-time autobattle.

games.name: Impossible Wonders

games.name: Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!!

games.name: Lantern Duel

games.name: Muster & Magic

Combine units, plan your formation, and cast spells to stop the hordes. Between runs, unlock allies and chart your path through a branching skill tree.

games.name: My Dirty Little Lake
games.summary: Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game. With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. games.name: Night of the Idle Horde
games.summary: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

games.name: Nullnest

games.name: Off the Table!
games.summary: A hand-drawn incremental game about a cat and a table full of things. Push coffee mugs, paperbacks and the Screaming toast onto the floor before your human gets back, then spend the points on stronger paws, more time and bigger tables.

games.name: Oh Shear!
games.summary: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

games.name: Olympegs
games.summary: Somewhere between Mount Olympus and the pit of Tartarus there are a great many pegs, and the gods would like them gone. Pick a god, take the shot, and try not to make Ares any angrier than he already is.

games.name: One Million Gallons
games.summary: Drain the ocean one bucket at a time. Scoop up water, sell it, and spend your cash on bigger buckets, a wheelbarrow, a golf cart, pumps and a crew of hard-working seagulls until the sea floor is bone dry and only the plug is left to pull.

games.summary: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies in this 3D survivors-like. Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

Origin Arts is a magic action RPG where you explore fortresses guarded by powerful dragons. Journey from mountain-ringed grasslands and lakes into diverse dungeons, including cities on the water and Gothic strongholds. Read enemy attacks, dodge, and time your perfect guards to stand your ground.

games.summary: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

PRIEST

games.name: Pufu
games.summary: Action packed 3D cat fighting game full of adventure, leveling and customization. Also funny.

games.name: Puzzles Are Better Together
games.summary: Puzzles Are Better Together is a cozy 3D jigsaw escape you can enjoy solo or with friends in online co-op. Slow down, lose yourself in beautiful high-resolution artwork, and let calming music, satisfying piece placement, and shared moments turn every puzzle into time well spent.

games.name: Quiz Show Simulator
games.summary: Run your own high-stakes quiz show by crafting questions, choosing contestants, and making production decisions to grow your audience, boost ratings, and earn more money!

games.name: Radio Fox Hunt
games.summary: Radio Fox Hunt is a simulator inspired by the sport of amateur radio direction finding.

games.name: Raise, Rise & Die
games.summary: A dark fantasy deckbuilder duel. You are held together by the souls you've absorbed — and every card you play costs you another one. Sacrifice from your hand, channel it through your weapon, and bring your opponent down. Designed on a table, with real cards, before a single line of code.

Languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Spanish.

Ringfort

games.name: ROKUMENSHU
games.summary: An auto battler RPG where every hero is a six-sided die. Read the enemy's dice, set your formation, swap new faces over old ones and load the dice. Then take your hands off the keyboard and watch fate roll across three chapters of Japanese folklore.

games.name: Savebot: The Last Garden
games.summary: A sleeping planet. A few robots who know nothing yet. And you, who know how to write programs. Teach them, block by block, to take care of the world, until life comes back on its own, across five worlds.

games.name: Seashell Hoarder
games.summary: A cozy first-person beachcombing game where you gather, clean, and shelve thousands of seashells along a sun-warmed coastline. Sort each find into its rightful place, restore the shore, and turn a scattered coastline into a curated collection at your own pace.

games.name: Shift 233
games.summary: You are a new employee at Station 4 on Shift 233 where you monitor microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. As you go further, what starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange presence within the cracks of the earth.

games.name: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem! Demo
Space Catnips
games.summary: Space Catnips is an incremental game where you harvest catnips from alien planets and showcase them in your bar to attract a wide variety of space cats!

games.name: Spearfish
games.summary: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: StackProsper
games.summary: Drop one card onto another and watch a 13th-century kingdom grow. Gather, build and raise your people, survive the seasons and hostile neighbors, then win by conquering their capitals or completing a grand cathedral.

games.name: Stealing Christmas
games.summary: This is your chance to be naughty this Christmas! Loot all gifts and decorations you can find and stash them away! Raid Santa's House and sabotage his Naughty-or-Nice operation! Stealing Christmas is a hidden object collection game with lighthearted humor.

games.name: SUPER DURAK
games.summary: Durak, the Russian card game everyone's grandmother plays, now with Supercards that break the rules. Bomb an attack, ricochet it to a neighbour, steal your rival's best card with a magnet, or reroll the trump. Play CPU opponents, a friend at the same screen, or anyone online.

games.name: Survidle Knight
games.summary: Enter the dungeon. Fight powerful foes. Die. Upgrade. Repeat. Survidle Knight is an idle RPG dungeon crawler with survivor-like elements and no input during gameplay.

games.name: SWARM GATE
games.summary: Hold the gate against ground and airborne swarms in a dark-fantasy defence shooter. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat powerful lords, then take direct control of unlocked heroes—turn, hover and strike back through a 30-day campaign and endless defence.

games.name: Swarmdle
games.summary: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, spend what you collect on weapons and upgrades between waves, and keep permanent upgrades when a run ends. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that every player in the world gets identically.

games.name: Task Bar Quest
games.summary: A free idle RPG that lives at the edge of your desktop. Choose your hero, battle monsters and bosses, collect powerful gear, and grow stronger with companions, crafting, mining, and fishing while you go about your day.

games.name: Temple Of The Machine God
games.summary: A first-person ambient horror game set at the end of time. Explore a vast machine superstructure built around a black hole by AI that refused to let the universe die — and couldn't follow humanity into whatever came next.

games.name: Temporal Distortion
games.summary: A board game of hex pebbles at a lamplit table, on four hostile worlds. Place a pebble, turn it to strike: higher numbers take lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Across the table, a patient stranger tells you whose story you're playing.

games.name: Tenant Gone!
games.summary: Turn messy apartments into fresh starts. Collect rubbish, vacuum dust and mop spills, then uncover forgotten cameras, records and collectibles. Bring your finds back to appraise, sell or display as you grow your own little clearance company.

games.name: The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe
games.summary: Take my order, brother! The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe is a short cafe-themed incremental game about feeding slimes in a Maid Cafe. Buy upgrades, feed slimes, and take your Maid Cafe to the top.

games.name: The Greedy Knight
games.summary: a snack-sized auto-battler roguelite. you pick the path, your heroes do the dying. bank their souls, delve again.

games.name: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver
games.summary: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver is a fast paced rogue-like platformer with an emphasis on fluid movement, satisfying combat, and fearsome challenges. With unique abilities to master, tightly generated levels, and the ever-looming threat of Death, each run has something new to experience.

games.name: The Legendary Sortsmith
games.summary: A legendary gnome blacksmith forges mythic weapons faster than anyone can put them away. You’re his apprentice. Haul, toss and sort 4,000+ swords, axes, hammers and cursed oddities in this first-person tidying game, solo or with up to 3 friends.

games.name: The Prometheus Saga
games.summary:
An unknown fleet is approaching, and only one ship can still leave. 

Build a colony, hold out against the waves in real time, unlock the secrets of xeno technology, then retake the twelve systems of the Road Home one by one, all the way to the homeworld of those who hunt you.

games.name: The Scratcher
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the JACKPOT and stop before you go BUST. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

games.name: The Worldtree and the Omamori Promise
Tidy Up: Street Market
games.summary: Tidy Up Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. Over 6,000 items are piled up around an open-air market: fruit, fish, shoes, flowers, toys and more. Carry each one to the right stall, earn money, buy upgrades, and turn a messy street into a full, colorful market.

games.name: Tinselwood
games.summary: Build your perfect Christmas town set in a snowy valley. Lay out the homes, markets, and workshops and let the elves do the rest. No budgets, no timers and no way to lose: just lanes, lights, falling snow and Christmas magic.

games.name: Train Goes Choo Choo
games.summary: A nostalgic window into Japanese slice-of-life, perfect for those who find peace in the quiet beauty of rural landscapes and the rhythmic flow of a journey. Just enjoy the view.

games.name: Tri Chapas
games.summary: Tri Chapas is a tactical, physics-based tabletop football game inspired by classic coin soccer. Flick one disc between the other two, never touch them, stay onside and work your way up the pitch to the goal. Plan the pass. Score the goal.

games.name: Tuftwood : Rug Tufting Simulation
games.summary: Tuft cozy rugs for a town full of customers. Stretch the cloth, fire the tufting gun, glue, flip, shave and carve each rug by hand, then deliver it to their home. Grow your little studio with new yarns, tools and decorations, or turn any picture into a rug of your own.

games.name: Umami
games.summary: Build a menu of real dishes and challenge animal chefs in a culinary strategy card game. Compare four tastes, risk random replacements, and use regional spices that affect both sides. Travel across six countries and discover traditional recipes.

games.name: Uncosy
games.summary: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

games.name: Watch and Whisper
games.summary: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!

games.name: Watermellionaire
games.summary: Watermellionaire is a Battle Royale matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard with an itchy trigger finger, only one person can come out on top.

games.name: Way Too Many Fish!
games.summary: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

games.name: We Are Surrounded
games.summary: Four heroes stand back to back on a floating island as hundreds of monsters close in. Place their rally points, then watch them fight on their own. Spend the loot on five upgrade trees, come back stronger and defeat the enemies.

games.name: White Christmas
games.summary: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

games.name: Who Framed The Cat?
games.summary: A cozy cat detective set in an isometric seaside neighborhood. Mandarin, a ginger cat, has been framed by a look-alike. He has seven days to find the culprit and prove his innocence to people who only hear him say "meow."

games.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
games.summary: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns to total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

games.name: Wildcat
games.summary: Wildcat is a top-down fast-paced roguelite dungeon crawler featuring powerful witchcraft and intense boss fights. Discover hundreds of items, combine them to master the elements, defeat guardians and rival witches, then rescue the lost cats!

games.name: Zaz Tower
games.summary: An incremental tower defense game: defend your tower against hordes attacking from every direction. Choose cards, combine powers, recruit heroes, and turn each defeat into permanent upgrades so you can return stronger.

games.name: Zili Diary escape against witch
games.summary: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

If there is a match of the month, you can get the cards. You will be able to finish the game to get a point if your cards are flush. You are also possible to continue the game. Can not score with each other and no game. The winner is who get more points total 12 times game. -Game record will be saved automatically. -Banner AD is displayed on the screen.-iPad is not supported.

Below the Stone
games.summary:
Below the Stone is a punishing pixel art roguelike about dwarves questing to reach the deepest depths. Each and every descent will lead to new adventures, where only the most determined players with many risked lives will be rewarded by the hidden world that lies Below the Stone.

Discover the lore of dwarves, the treasures they die for, and the secrets they rarely speak of. Within the stone below lies the adventure everyone seeks, but there's always a price. Often death.

games.summary: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Help, My Capybaras Escaped!
games.summary: Help, My Capybaras Escaped is a casual and fun hidden object game where you have to rescue all the capybaras in various colourful images!

games.name: Leeway
games.summary: Buy cheap, sell dear, and don't sink. Or rob everyone and spend the gold before the navy catches you. Leeway is a physics-first age-of-sail game where every knot of wind and every ton of cargo matters. Peer-to-peer multiplayer.

games.name: Linkominoes
games.summary: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game about overlapping squares. Careful placement and spatial planning are essential as unique challenges demand different tactical approaches.

games.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure Soundtrack
Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

games.name: No Sleep Tonight
games.summary: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

games.name: OKUREK
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: POPUCOM
games.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

games.name: Shirt Happens!
games.summary: Build a t-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 10. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it.

games.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
games.summary: Run a cozy magical pawnshop where you buy cursed junk, uncover ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, haggle with eccentric customers, and turn magical trash into profit.

games.name: Sploink
games.summary: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

games.name: Stevedore
games.summary: No more job in the city. Managed to find one in the middle of nowhere. Stevedore. Crane worker. It feels off, but you need money. Stevedore is a short industrial horror game where you take a role of a crane worker. Lift containers, load ships and complete your contract. What could go wrong?

games.summary: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

games.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour
games.summary: An unknown number texts you at work. She’s cute, flirty, ginger… and her bust keeps growing for no clear reason. Reply carefully, don’t slack off too much, and unlock every ending in this short texting visual novel.

games.name: BEAR THE BURN: A Stock Market Deckbuilder
Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
games.summary: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.

games.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
Figment
games.summary: Figment is an action-adventure game that invites you to explore a unique surreal universe filled with music, humor and multi layered narrative. Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

games.name: Figment 2: Creed Valley
games.summary: Figment 2: Creed Valley is an action-adventure game set in the human mind. Nightmares are spreading chaos and enemies have overrun once-peaceful lands. Join Dusty, the Mind’s courage, as you make your way through puzzles, musical boss fights and unique environments. Face your fears head-on. Nightmares have shattered the Moral Compass, making The Mind unable to function properly. Dusty and his ever-optimistic sidekick, Piper, must travel to Creed Valley, where The Mind’s ideals are formed to restore peace. A journey filled with musical showdowns and mind-bending puzzles awaits.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Kids Minesweeper
games.summary:
Chop down trees, dodge slimes, and explore the forest! Use numbers as clues to identify dangerous tiles. A pixel-art puzzle game for kids and adults alike!

Kids Minesweeper is a pixel-art puzzle game where you use numbers as clues to figure out which tiles are safe.

Cut down the trees covering the forest and investigate one tile at a time.
When you cut down a tree, you may uncover a wooden sign carved with a number.

Each number tells you how many slimes are hiding in the eight surrounding tiles.
Use the numbers as clues to identify safe tiles and continue your expedition without running into slimes.

You can also place markers on tiles you suspect are dangerous.
Deciding which tiles to investigate and which ones to mark is the key to success!

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Medical Girls
games.summary:
A Puzzle Game Featuring Women Working in the Medical Field!

Collect puzzle pieces featuring women working in the noble field of medicine and complete each puzzle!

There are 15 stages in total, with the difficulty increasing as you progress!

Stages 1–10 feature 30 pieces, while stages 11–15 feature 50 pieces.

The final stage offers an extra challenge with no faded background image to guide you! Take your time examining each piece and put the puzzle together!

Complete a puzzle to unlock a high-resolution illustration in the gallery.

games.name: My Life: Safari Vet
games.summary: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!

games.name: My Pet Seduced Me: Save Animal Boys from the Monster
games.summary:
Your pet came back as a cute guy with ears and a tail. Now he needs you to save the others.

Your quiet Japanese town woke up different.

The pets are gone. In their place: monsters prowling the streets, and a handful of animal boys who somehow kept their hearts. Ears, tails, sharp style, and feelings they're not shy about.

Yours found you first. Turns out he's had a crush on you for a while.

Head out and find the others before the monsters do. Sneak past corrupted pets or take them down, learn new attacks, and meet the animal boys hiding in parks, side streets, and train platforms.

Spend time with them. Get closer. Every boy you win over heals you, shares his power with you, and unlocks illustrations and scenes in your gallery.

-A cat boy who acts cool but wants your attention anyway.
-A dog boy who'd follow you anywhere.
-A bunny boy who's all nerves, until he isn't.

Fall for them. Fight for them. Then face the bosses running this town.

games.name: My Pet Seduced Me: Save Animal Girls from the Monster
games.summary:
Your cat just turned into a girl. She's flirting with you. And the town is crawling with monster pets.

Something weird happened in your quiet little Japanese town.

Overnight, the pets changed. Most of them turned into aggressive monsters that now roam the streets. A lucky few turned into something else entirely: gorgeous animal girls with ears, tails, and plenty of attitude.

Including yours. And she's very happy to see you.

Explore the town, fight or run from corrupted pets, and track down the animal girls hiding in parks, back alleys, train stations, and convenience stores.

Ask them out. Win them over.

Every heart you conquer heals you, gives you new powers, and unlocks illustrations for your gallery.

The stronger your bonds, the stronger you get. You'll need it, because the biggest and weirdest bosses in town are waiting.

-A clingy cat girl who won't leave you alone.
-A loyal dog girl who'd fight a monster for you.
-A shy bunny girl who's way bolder than she looks.

games.name: MYSTHORN GIRLS
games.summary:
A Puzzle Game Featuring a Cast of MYST HORN GIRLS!

Collect the pieces featuring adorable girls with mystical horns and complete each puzzle!

There are 15 stages in total, with the difficulty increasing as you progress!

Stages 1–10 feature 30 pieces, while stages 11–15 feature 50 pieces.

The final stage offers an extra challenge with no faded background image to guide you! Take your time examining each piece and put the puzzle together!

Complete a puzzle to unlock a high-resolution illustration in the gallery

games.name: Once You Know the Truth, These Comics Become Scary
Pack The Cats
games.summary:
One box. Too many cats. Absolutely no personal space. Getting them all in? That's the cozy puzzle games.

If I fits, I sits. The trouble is, every cat wants to sit in the same box. Find a place for each stubborn kitty and enjoy that perfect click when everyone settles in.

With charming illustrated cats, warm colors and a calm pace, it's the purrfect pick for a quick break, a cozy evening or anyone who has ever watched a cat squeeze into a box far too small for it.

Every level gives you a grid and a crowd of cats waiting for their turn. Some curl into a neat little loaf, some stretch out long and tall, and some sprawl across the board with a tail that goes wherever it pleases. Every one of them is an original, hand-drawn character.

Plan around the yarn balls, try different arrangements and find the one layout where every cat has room to rest. There's no rush - just you, a box full of kitties and that wonderful feeling when the last cat finally slips into place.

games.name: Rainbow Romance: College Boys in Love
games.summary:
He says you’re just his buddy. So why is he still texting you at 2 a.m.?

On paper, this college is the straightest place on earth. Big games, loud parties, guys who never stop talking about girls. Funny how none of them ever seem to have one around.

Look closer and the cracks start to show. The hug that lasts a second too long. The joke that isn’t really a joke. The text that arrives at 2 a.m. and is gone by morning.

The swim captain with a girlfriend he never mentions. The musician who writes love songs and won’t say who they’re for. The top student who swears he has no time for distractions, then saves you a seat every single day. They all have a story they’re not telling.

Every conversation pulls the truth a little closer, or makes him back off. Move too fast and he panics. Say the right thing and he finally drops his guard. In private chat, he’s a different guy entirely.

The pool after practice. The empty music room. The long walk back from the party when everyone else is gone. This campus is full of secrets, and some of them are about you.

games.name: Rainbow Romance: College Girls in Love
games.summary:
A crush she’d never admit to anyone. Except you. Thirty days to make her prove it.

Everyone at this college has it all figured out. Perfect boyfriends, perfect photos, perfect stories. At least, that’s what they want you to believe.

Behind the smiles, every girl here is hiding something. A glance that lasts too long. A message deleted before it’s sent. A secret she’s never told anyone, not even herself.

The volleyball captain with the boyfriend everyone envies. The class president who claims she has no time for romance. The party girl who kisses anyone on a dare and calls it a joke. Each one has a reason to keep you at arm’s length, and you have thirty days to find out if it’s real.

Every conversation is a test. Push too hard and she shuts down. Read her right and the mask slips, just for a moment. And in private chat, she says things she’d never admit out loud.

The library after closing. The rooftop when the party gets too loud. The walk home when she finally stops pretending. This campus keeps its secrets well. You’re about to learn every one of them.

games.name: Relic Looter
games.summary: Explore Ancient Ruins and Mysterious Temples! Dodge Deadly Traps and Discover Legendary Treasures! Grab the Loot. Escape Alive!

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Ritebound
games.summary: Guide a group of cultists to a mysterious portal! Place boxes, build bridges and stairs, use trampolines, avoid deadly traps, and find the right path through 40 puzzle-platforming levels.

games.name: Spin Girlfriend! ~Secret Date at the Water Park~
STEEL VANGUARD:Project ARES
games.summary: Set in a sci-fi world, this top-down shooter challenges you to complete missions and earn the title of “ARES,” the strongest pilot. Collect modules that appear after clearing each wave to customize and upgrade your mech as you see fit, and aim to clear every wave all the way to the end.

games.name: Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen
games.summary:
In this game, you will work with the Sumikko characters to help out at a busy hot spring inn that is short-staffed, aiming to make it a popular inn where everyone can gather. You will work hard at various jobs such as guiding guests and cleaning, adding new facilities and making it a wonderful hot spring inn.

Use the coins that guests earn by using the facilities to open shops, game corners, and more to develop the inn. The more facilities you add and the higher your level, the more coins you earn, and the more facilities you can open! You can enjoy the excitement of expanding your possibilities and the sense of accomplishment as your inn becomes more lively.

This game offers endless fun and replayability. In this game, you'll experience the satisfaction of gradually expanding a quiet hot spring inn into a vibrant place, while enjoying a relaxing hot spring life with the comical and adorable Sumikko characters.

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary:
It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s addicting. 

Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. 
Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. 
Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier. 
Can you make it to the end and defeat their leader? 

Play alone. Play with your friends. Play against your friends. 

- Play the single-player campaign to practice your skills and beat the game by yourself. 
- Finish the campaign with 2 players in the co-op mode. 
- Defeat your friends in the VS Mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Test Tube Water Sort Quiz: Can You Sort the Colors in the Fewest Moves?
The Abjuration Stand
games.summary: Defend yourself from hordes of green slimes as a tiny wizard! Build magical orbs, upgrade your weapons, and survive across different locations — from mountains to graveyards. Simple and dynamic 2D defense.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
Thexder
games.summary:
Direct from Japan, where game design is treated as an art form, comes Thexder, an arcade game by which all others will soon be judged. Thexder offers more music, animation and game play, than you ever thought possible from a computer game.

In Thexder, players are given the chance to pilot a robot through multiple attack scenarios. The battlefields include caves, vast cargo holds and spaceship interiors. The robot also has the unique ability to transform into a fighter jet (and back again) at the touch of a button. Over 20 different types of aliens will do battle with you, and the challenge and music escalates as the game progresses.

games.name: THINK! LEARN! School Smarts: General Knowledge Quiz Battle
Tile Tales: Pirate
games.summary:
Slide tiles, dodge trouble, and hunt for treasure!

Arrr, matey! Get ready for a puzzle adventure packed with pirate mischief, treasure hunting, and tile-sliding chaos!

Help one hopelessly treasure-obsessed pirate find his way across a remote island paradise. Solve 60 uniquely handcrafted puzzles across 6 charming chapters, each with its own lush environment to explore. Along the way, he’ll meet quirky characters, dodge dangerous foes, brave tricky traps, and stumble through more trouble than any pirate deserves.

May your sails be taut and your coffers be full, matey!

games.name: Time Machine : Hidden Objects
games.summary:
Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure through space and time! 

Herbert Fink, a young scientist, faces difficult yet fascinating challenges. An ordinary trip out of town turns into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

Colorful scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun. Those with a competitive streak can collect bonuses for speed and repeat the quest with new puzzles

games.name: UMAMI (2025)
games.summary: UMAMI is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.

Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, you’ll need to overcome the challenges of each biome to complete your mission.

games.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
Chess Variant: Chase The King Demo
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 1
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 2
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 3

Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
MEIFU KANSHIKI-KA: The Underworld Forensics Division
The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.

Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Seri & Yuka with my heart Demo
Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
Tell Me How I Can Hurt You
The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party
games.summary:
Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop.
Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match.

Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go.

11 MAPS, 11 WAYS TO FALL
• Rooftop: "Don't look down. Also, it smells like pizza."
• Wrestling Ring: the floor is bouncy, the folding chairs are not.
• Space Station: zero gravity, and the airlock opens every 20–30 seconds.
• Luxury Cruise: five-star accommodation on a tiny wooden raft.
• Airplane: fight on the wings. It gets windy.
• Plus Broken Bridge, Camp, Construction Site, Cliff and two football pitches.

STUFF DROPS FROM THE SKY
Frying pans. Air horns that make everyone in front of you dizzy. A leaf blower. A bee hive thrower. A jetpack. A bomb nobody wants to hold. Homing rockets. 18 items drop at random, so every round goes a bit differently.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Last Man Standing: knock everyone out or off the map. The last one standing takes the round. First to 4, 6 or 8 wins.
• Football: yellow vs blue soccer, with ragdolls. Every goal gets slow motion, confetti and a roaring crowd.
• Randomized: every map from both modes in a shuffled order.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 1–4 players on one screen, plus up to 4 bots, for up to 8 fighters.
• Playing alone? Take on the bots.
• Charge a power punch, land a homing flying kick, then taunt with 13 emotes like "EASY!" and "OOPS!"
• Turn on Slow Motion for the whole match.

COMFORT SETTINGS
Screen shake slider, a toggle for comic hit words, Reduce Flashing, six volume sliders and controller vibration controls.

11 achievements, including Pizza Delivery Failed and Wrong Net, Champion.

Bungle Brawl is a local multiplayer game played on one screen. It has no online multiplayer.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.summary:
Step up to the challenge and take a risk in the world of Storage Hunter Simulator, where you'll compete against others for the ultimate prize - garages filled with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered! In this exciting game, you'll have the chance to showcase your skills and become a giant of the storage market!

In this simulation game, you'll need to master the art of auctions, selling valuable items to wealthy collectors, and improving your skills as an appraiser to stay ahead of the competition. But that's just the beginning - the storage empire is waiting for you!

games.name: Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Astro Chef: Cosmic Kitchen
games.summary:
Hunt. Cook. Sell. Upgrade. The galaxy is hungry!

The galaxy's favorite space diner is open… but the pantry's empty!

Astro Chef: Cosmic Kitchen is a cozy cooking adventure powered by fast, auto-attacking dungeon runs. Suit up as a bubble-helmeted astronaut chef, dive into monster-filled planets, and scoop up the ingredients your foes drop. Back in the kitchen, cook them in your cauldron and sell the dishes to a line of hungry aliens. Every coin goes into a giant Skill Tree, so each run hits harder, lasts longer, and pays more.

HUNT ON 4 PLANETS
Fight your way down 4 floors on each of Mushroom Planet, Aquarium Moon, Lava Forest, and Crystal Mine. Your main attack fires on its own: just move, aim, and mow through swarms of 13 monster types, from Spore Shrooms to Crystal Fairies. Deeper worlds bring toxic slime, biting flytraps, and falling crystals.

COOK UP 16 RECIPES
Find recipe scrolls in the dungeons, toss your haul into the cauldron, and serve up Spore Soup, Cockatrice Sushi, Galaxy Dumplings, Milky Way Ice Cream, and more. Add a pinch of seasoning and a dish sells for three times the price.

SERVE THE GALAXY
Alien customers line up at your counter. Stack servings into silver, gold, and cosmic dishes, chain sales combos, and watch your gold climb from a handful of coins into the trillions.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary:
You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware - there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: SAI-KYO-OH! Clash Battle Kings
games.summary:
The "Strongest King Encyclopedia," a series popular among elementary school students through books and anime, is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 as a battle action game!

Control powerful warriors selected from insect, animal, extinct animal, dinosaur, and dragon species and win a chaotic brawl!

Will you take on the challenge alone or battle with friends? Get fired up in two modes!

games.name: Station to Station
games.summary: Station to Station’is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

games.name: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
Solve the impossible. Expose the truth. Uncover the secrets of The Penrose Hotel in this atmospheric first person puzzle thriller.

Welcome to The Penrose. Service is impeccable and the rooms are immaculate. You’re its most valued guest, but you can’t remember checking in.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is a first-person puzzle thriller created by Dan Smith, Winner of the 2016 BAFTA Young Game Designer Award.

You are Alex. You awaken inside The Penrose, an unsettling art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world. Its corridors are quiet, its staff endlessly attentive, and each day follows a familiar routine. Guided by the voice of a mysterious stranger, you begin searching for the truth about why you are here.

Your escape hinges on solving The Spectrum Retreat’s series of intricate logic and spatial challenges. Absorb and swap colors to slip through security barriers, redirect energy, manipulate your surroundings and rethink the rules of each space. But every puzzle solved brings you closer to something The Penrose would rather keep hidden.

Beneath the hotel’s facade lies a story of memory and grief. You’ll need to decide whether some realities are better left undisturbed.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux rebuilds the award-winning original for Nintendo Switch™ 2, with:
- Entirely rebuilt lighting and reflections
- Increased fidelity with HDR support
- Nintendo Switch 2™ features: HD Rumble 2 and mouse controls

games.name: GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: MR. ELEVATOR
games.summary: Hello, I'm Mr. Elevator. Are you seeking a bizarre puzzle game? If you want a game where five people in an elevator explore a strange world drawn like early Windows Paint, listening to odd symbols and sounds to solve mysteries and descend to the deep floors, this is it.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary: Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. Build your dream farm, master professions, collect magical Lumas, find treasures and unravel the mysteries of the island.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
games.summary:
Take flight in this remastered 'stick control era' aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

You take on the role of Falconeer, a powerful airborne warrior traversing a vast oceanic world torn apart by generations of poisonous decisions and dissent. Throughout multiple campaigns, you will experience life from many different perspectives and loyalties as you embark on a journey of discovery, and solve the mystery of the Ursee, its people and history.

Progress through perilous missions and side quests, wielding your lightning caster to protect ships against pirates, kraken and other threats. Dive through the deep ocean depths, soar above the clouds to do battle with giant crab cities or engage in furious dogfights against the mysterious Mancer Order that controls and regulates technology.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed
games.summary:
Side Effects Guaranteed is the first of a two-part narrative DLC experience, and its events will have ramifications in the second installment which is not not guaranteed to be named More Side Effects Guaranteed. So come get your increased level cap, new perks, new flaws, new radio station, and new weapons – not to mention the chance decide the fate of an isolated Protectorate settlement AND the Sub Rosa faction!

That’s right, this DLC is about frightened subjects trying to survive while outlaws of questionable ethics vie for power. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary: Hello! Bouncy Bernard is a cute doggy that likes fun a lot. Puzzles is one of his favorite. However, this is not only about fun. He is very smart and is fond of discovering the world as well. He invites you to accompany him in doing this. Today he wants to be with you to discover striking representations of well-known racing cars and vehicles. There are Formula 1 car, motorcycles, NASCAR racing cars, rally cars, monster trucks, snowmobiles and water scooters. So, as you can see there is huge collection of objects to became familiar with and have fun in playing puzzles along with Bouncy Bernard. Don’t wait any longer! Main features: - Interactive puzzles parts for children aged 3+. - Three levels of difficulty (6 parts, 12 parts, 20 parts puzzles). - Beautiful and realistic 3D pictures that are created to both entertain and educate children. - Intuitive navigation. - Drag and drop puzzle pieces. Tap a piece to make it large, move into the place of destination and release. - Gray, faded picture background facilitating matching pieces. - Supporting sound effects. - Switch on / off music function.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
games.summary:
With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! 

Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

Show dirt who’s boss in a sleek new look that takes power dressing to a whole new level. Accessorize with a range of practical and chic tools and attachments that make cleaning up a dream. Trade in the pink convertible and take your new abseiling kit and scissor lift for a spin to help hunt dirt high and low.

Ever wanted to ride the DreamHouse elevator from the point of view of Barbie? Or chill by the fire in front of the Dream Camper? Now you can. Escape to the ideal destination where the only pressure is in the water, as you blast away dirt from five new levels teeming with Barbie playsets and accessories.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary:
Experience a macabre, short-form, second-person indie, you play as The Dark Queen of Mortholme, the final barrier between the Hero and the end credits. 

In this fixed-screen pixel art game, use the Queen's attacks against this hero, slay them, and quell this nuisance once and for all. 

But, wait. How is this possible? The Hero keeps coming back. 

Depending on your dialogue choices, the story will play out differently. Will you see the Hero's point of view, or continue ruling as the Queen Everlasting?

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
